GiftingService.luau.description: Persists GameConfig-backed pass and developer-product gifts, applies social restrictions, and integrates paid gift fulfillment with GameProductService. Public entry points include `GiftingService.Init`, `GiftingService.Start`, `GiftingService.SetPlayerGiftRestriction`, `GiftingService.GetPlayerGiftRestriction`, `GiftingService.RegisterGiftProduct`, `GiftingService.CanGiftAsync`, `GiftingService.GiftAsync`,…
